scoring_justification: Headline structural and electronic quantities require full DFT runs; the checker cannot recompute them from raw artifacts. The checker compares the agent's reported values to the paper's PBE-GGA reference using implementation-tolerant thresholds.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference GGA values for lattice constants, bulk moduli, valence bandwidths, Γ-X band gaps, total DOS at EF, and B-p DOS at EF for Be2B, AlBeB, MgBeB, NaBeB, taken from Tables 1 and 2 of the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the published paper text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the actual reported results of the original DFT study, not invented; they constitute the authoritative hidden gold for reproduction.

schema.description: Array of four objects, one per compound, in the fixed order: Be2B, AlBeB, MgBeB, NaBeB.

bulk_modulus_GPa.description: Bulk modulus from Murnaghan EOS fit

valence_bandwidth_eV.description: Valence bandwidth (top of valence band minus bottom of lowest valence band)

band_gap_Gamma_X_eV.description: Γ-X band gap (lowest conduction band at X minus highest valence band at Γ)

total_DOS_at_EF_states_per_eV_cell.description: Total density of states at the Fermi level

B_p_DOS_at_EF_states_per_eV_cell.description: B p-projected DOS at the Fermi level

outputs.description: Contains the six computed properties for each of the four antifluorite compounds. The checker compares each value to the paper's GGA reference using predefined relative tolerances.

output_contract.notes: Only GGA (PBE) results are required; the LDA values are not scored. The agent must use an open-source plane-wave/pseudopotential DFT code and choose appropriate convergence parameters (k‑points, cutoff). The output order is fixed.
